package com.acme.order.service;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyInt;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyString;
import static org.mockito.BDDMockito.given;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

import com.acme.order.domain.Order;
import com.acme.order.domain.OrderStatus;
import com.acme.order.exception.OrderLimitExceededException;
import com.acme.order.exception.OrderNotFoundException;
import com.acme.order.exception.OutOfStockException;
import com.acme.order.notification.NotificationException;
import com.acme.order.notification.NotificationService;
import com.acme.order.notification.OrderEvent;
import com.acme.order.repository.OrderRepository;
import com.acme.order.service.command.PlaceOrderCommand;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.Optional;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Disabled;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.CsvSource;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;
import org.mockito.Captor;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;

/**
 * Unit tests for {@link OrderServiceImpl}.
 *
 * <p>Mockito only, no Spring context. Collaborators: repository, inventory, notifier.
 */
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class OrderServiceImplTest {

    private static final String SKU = "SKU-1001";

    @Mock
    private OrderRepository orderRepository;

    @Mock
    private InventoryService inventoryService;

    @Mock
    private NotificationService notifier;

    @InjectMocks
    private OrderServiceImpl service;

    @Captor
    private ArgumentCaptor<OrderEvent> eventCaptor;

    private PlaceOrderCommand command;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        command = new PlaceOrderCommand("CUST-7", SKU, 3, new BigDecimal("19.90"));
    }

    @Test
    void shouldPlaceOrderWhenStockAvailable() {
        when(inventoryService.reserve(SKU, 3)).thenReturn(true);
        when(orderRepository.save(any(Order.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> withId(inv.getArgument(0), 501L));

        Order placed = service.placeOrder(command);

        assertThat(placed.getId()).isEqualTo(501L);
        assertThat(placed.getStatus()).isEqualTo(OrderStatus.CONFIRMED);
        assertThat(placed.getTotal()).isEqualByComparingTo("59.70");
        verify(inventoryService, times(1)).reserve(SKU, 3);
        verify(notifier, times(1)).send(eventCaptor.capture());
        assertThat(eventCaptor.getValue().orderId()).isEqualTo(501L);
        assertThat(eventCaptor.getValue().type()).isEqualTo(OrderEvent.Type.PLACED);
    }

    @Test
    void placeOrder_nullCommand_throwsIllegalArgument() {
        IllegalArgumentException ex = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> service.placeOrder(null));
        assertEquals("command must not be null", ex.getMessage());
        verifyNoInteractions(orderRepository, inventoryService, notifier);
    }

    @Test
    void given_quantityAboveLimit_when_placeOrder_then_limitExceeded() {
        PlaceOrderCommand tooMany = new PlaceOrderCommand("CUST-7", SKU, 101, BigDecimal.ONE);

        assertThrows(OrderLimitExceededException.class, () -> service.placeOrder(tooMany));

        verify(inventoryService, never()).reserve(anyString(), anyInt());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("quantity == MAX_QUANTITY (100) is still accepted")
    void quantityAtLimitIsAccepted() {
        PlaceOrderCommand atLimit = new PlaceOrderCommand("CUST-7", SKU, 100, BigDecimal.ONE);
        when(inventoryService.reserve(SKU, 100)).thenReturn(true);
        when(orderRepository.save(any(Order.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        Order placed = service.placeOrder(atLimit);

        assertThat(placed.getQuantity()).isEqualTo(100);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldThrowOutOfStockWhenReservationFails() {
        given(inventoryService.reserve(SKU, 3)).willReturn(false);

        OutOfStockException ex = assertThrows(OutOfStockException.class, () -> service.placeOrder(command));

        assertThat(ex.getSku()).isEqualTo(SKU);
        verify(orderRepository, never()).save(any());
        verifyNoInteractions(notifier);
    }

    @Test
    void notificationFailure_doesNotFailTheOrder() {
        when(inventoryService.reserve(SKU, 3)).thenReturn(true);
        when(orderRepository.save(any(Order.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> withId(inv.getArgument(0), 502L));
        doThrow(new NotificationException("smtp down")).when(notifier).send(any(OrderEvent.class));

        Order placed = service.placeOrder(command);

        assertThat(placed.getId()).isEqualTo(502L);
    }

    @Test
    @Disabled
    void shouldRequireApprovalAboveCreditLimit() {
        PlaceOrderCommand big = new PlaceOrderCommand("CUST-9", SKU, 60, new BigDecimal("100.00"));
        when(inventoryService.reserve(SKU, 60)).thenReturn(true);
        when(orderRepository.save(any(Order.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        assertThat(service.placeOrder(big).getStatus()).isEqualTo(OrderStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL);
    }

    @Test
    void test3() {
        when(orderRepository.findById(404L)).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

        assertThrows(OrderNotFoundException.class, () -> service.getOrder(404L));
    }

    @Test
    void cancelOrder_confirmed_releasesStockAndCancels() {
        Order order = order(7L, OrderStatus.CONFIRMED);
        when(orderRepository.findById(7L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(order));
        when(orderRepository.save(order)).thenReturn(order);

        Order cancelled = service.cancelOrder(7L, "customer request");

        assertThat(cancelled.getStatus()).isEqualTo(OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
        verify(inventoryService).release(SKU, 3);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldCancelConfirmedOrder() {
        Order order = order(7L, OrderStatus.CONFIRMED);
        when(orderRepository.findById(7L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(order));
        when(orderRepository.save(order)).thenReturn(order);

        Order cancelled = service.cancelOrder(7L, "customer request");

        assertThat(cancelled.getStatus()).isEqualTo(OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
        verify(inventoryService).release(SKU, 3);
    }

    @Test
    void cancelOrder_pendingApproval_doesNotReleaseStock() {
        Order order = order(8L, OrderStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL);
        when(orderRepository.findById(8L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(order));
        when(orderRepository.save(order)).thenReturn(order);

        service.cancelOrder(8L, "duplicate");

        verify(inventoryService, never()).release(anyString(), anyInt());
        assertThat(order.getCancellationReason()).isEqualTo("duplicate");
    }

    @Test
    void cancelOrder_shipped_throwsIllegalState() {
        Order order = order(9L, OrderStatus.SHIPPED);
        when(orderRepository.findById(9L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(order));

        try {
            service.cancelOrder(9L, "changed mind");
        } catch (IllegalStateException expected) {
            // expected: shipped orders cannot be cancelled
        }
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRetryNotification() throws InterruptedException {
        when(inventoryService.reserve(SKU, 3)).thenReturn(true);
        when(orderRepository.save(any(Order.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> withId(inv.getArgument(0), 503L));

        service.placeOrder(command);
        Thread.sleep(1500); // give the outbox relay time to retry { flaky on slow agents }

        verify(notifier, times(2)).send(any(OrderEvent.class));
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "zone {0}, {1} g -> {2} cents")
    @CsvSource({
            "50, 500, 1940",
            "57, 1500, 2195",
            "59, 19999, 3685"
    })
    void calculatesFee(final int zone, final int grams, final int expectedCents) {
        assertThat(service.calculateFee(zone, grams)).isEqualTo(expectedCents);
    }

    @Test
    void discountTiers() {
        assertThat(service.discountFor(60)).isEqualTo(500);
        assertThat(service.discountFor(10)).isEqualTo(250);
    }

    private static Order order(final long id, final OrderStatus status) {
        Order order = Order.newOrder("CUST-7", SKU, 3, new BigDecimal("59.70"));
        order.setId(id);
        order.setStatus(status);
        return order;
    }

    private static Order withId(final Order order, final long id) {
        order.setId(id);
        return order;
    }
}
